Classes / Prosthetics (PTX)

Professional · Prosthetics

Prosthetics Makeup Training (Making and Applying PTX)

A 10-day prosthetics makeup course: live casting, molding and sculpting, silicone, latex, and gelatin work, application and removal — build film-grade pieces from scratch.

Send an inquiry Course details

Who this course is for

Artists ready for the deepest craft in the industry: prosthetic fabrication and application for film, TV, and high-end events.

PHP 50,000

per student · all materials included

Send an inquiry

Tuition includes all training materials, certificate, portfolio images, and OJT opportunities.

What you will cover

  1. 01

    Introduction and Safety

    The craft, the materials, how the industry uses them, contents and hazards, and setting up a professional kit and workstation.

  2. 02

    Design and Live Casts

    Design pieces from character reference to final form, then take accurate casts of a live subject.

  3. 03

    Molding and Sculpting

    Sculpt and mold your designs with precision.

  4. 04

    Latex, Silicone, Gelatine, and Foam

    Work across the four core prosthetic materials.

  5. 05

    Adhesives and Paints

    Apply, blend, and paint pieces to match skin.

  6. 06

    Teeth and Hair Makeup

    Complete characters with dental and hair effects.

  7. 07

    Removal, Storage, and Aftercare

    Safe, clean removal that protects the talent, and keeping pieces and kits in professional condition.

What you will receive

  • — All training materials provided
  • — Certificate of completion
  • — Portfolio images of your work
  • — OJT at film, TV, stage, and theatre performances
  • — 10% discount on succeeding courses
  • — Makeup Academy Manila welcome gift

How training works

Ten days from design to finished character: you cast, sculpt, mold, run, apply, paint, and remove your own pieces under working-artist supervision, building a film-grade portfolio as you go.
